messages.author: ec4a5e203578d742
messages.subject: Unable to install package RJDBC when Packrat selected
parts:
Hi

Tried to install RJDBC in R-studio 0.99.486 (R 3.2.2) on ubuntu 15.04, it failed with:
Error in library(RJDBC) : there is no package called ‘RJDBC’

Turned Packrat off from project options and manged to install it. Now Packrat is again selected and everything seems to be fine. 

            -Niko-

messages.subject: Re: Unable to install package RJDBC when Packrat selected

Are you trying to install it from a local repository? Did you download it from github? 
In that case it would help adding 'Repository: CRAN' to the DESCRIPTION file before building the package and adding it to the local repository.
